_comment: Eager-FP16 runtime for the lean proton-MRI image.
Dose checkpoint: exact e27 fixed-mask v2 model from 2026-08-26,
Disables torch.compile and its health-startup warmup while retaining the
FP16 dose correction and two-patch FP16 MRI-to-sCT forwards.
Patch batch 2 measured 1.50x faster than patch batch 1; larger batches did not improve it.
Tail padding is disabled because it only serves compiled fixed-batch graphs.
